llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究高熵合金的SLM制造与热处理强化，未涉及生物医用植入物的应力屏蔽、多孔结构或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, porous structures for stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses solely on mechanical strengthening of a high entropy alloy via annealing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究退火处理对SLM成形Al0.3CoCrFeNiCu高熵合金的强化效果
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备合金并进行退火处理，通过显微组织表征和力学测试分析
summary_zh.result: 退火引入L12析出相显著提升合金强度
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸或硬度测试验证力学性能提升

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the strengthening effect of annealing-induced L12 precipitates on a selective laser melted Al0.3CoCrFeNiCu high entropy alloy.
summary_en.method: The alloy was fabricated by selective laser melting and subsequently annealed; microstructural characterization and mechanical testing were performed.
summary_en.result: Annealing introduced L12 precipitates that significantly enhanced the strength of the alloy.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (e.g., tensile or hardness) confirmed the strength improvement.

papers.title: THE EFFECT OF MACHINING PROCESSES ON THE PHYSICAL AND SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Ti6Al4V SPECIMENS PRODUCED THROUGH POWDER BED FUSION ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING
papers.abstract: The most critical component of Industry 4.0, the new face of the machinery-manufacturing industry sector, is metal additive manufacturing. Laser-based additive manufacturing techniques are dominant for metal additive manufacturing today. In this study, the metal alloy studied is Ti-6Al-4V, one of the essential Ti alloys used in more than 50% of all commercial Ti applications. Ti-6Al-4V parts produced by additive manufacturing are used in the biomedical, aerospace-defence industry, and industrial areas due to their high strength, fatigue behaviour, fracture strength, good corrosion resistance, and biocompatibility. In the study, samples of Ti6Al4V alloy were produced with different manufacturing parameters by the direct metal laser sintering (DMLS) method, which is one of the powder bed fusion methods. Then, the surface qualities of the samples were processed by milling and wire EDM. The effects of machining operations on the surface roughness of the samples were investigated and compared with the surface roughness obtained from the samples produced by the DMLS method. After the optical microscope images of the samples were taken, the physical and surface morphology were examined. Although the mechanical properties of the parts manufactured by DMLS methods were higher, the samples with machining presented higher machinability with lower forces, lower surface roughness. the This is explained that mechanical properties of samples of Ti6Al4V alloy in additive manufacturing are highly dependent on the rapid cooling of the material. Results show that samples of Ti6Al4V manufactured by additive manufacturing has been possible using with machining.
papers.venue: International Journal of 3D Printing Technologies and Digital Industry

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了增材制造Ti6Al4V合金的后加工表面粗糙度，与生物医用植入物的表面形态相关，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: Does not link porous structure to stress shielding, does not report fatigue behavior, and lacks comprehensive mechanical testing specific to implant applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究不同加工工艺对增材制造Ti6Al4V合金表面粗糙度和形貌的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用直接金属激光烧结制备样品，并通过铣削和线切割进行后处理。
summary_zh.result: 加工后的样品表面粗糙度更低，加工性能更好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过光学显微镜和粗糙度测量进行表征。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of machining processes (milling and wire EDM) on the surface roughness and morphology of Ti6Al4V specimens fabricated by powder bed fusion (DMLS).
summary_en.method: Ti6Al4V samples were produced via DMLS with varying parameters, followed by machining operations.
summary_en.result: The machined samples exhibited lower surface roughness and improved machinability compared to as-built ones.
summary_en.validation: Surface characterization via optical microscopy and roughness measurements.

papers.title: Is three-dimensional-printed custom-made ultra-short stem with a porous structure an acceptable reconstructive alternative in peri-knee metaphysis for the tumorous bone defect?
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Long-lasting reconstruction after extensive resection involving peri-knee metaphysis is a challenging problem in orthopedic oncology. Various reconstruction methods have been proposed, but they are characterized by a high complication rate. The purposes of this study were to (1) assess osseointegration at the bone implant interface and correlated incidence of aseptic loosening; (2) identify complications including infection, endoprosthesis fracture, periprosthetic fracture, leg length discrepancy, and wound healing problem in this case series; and (3) evaluate the short-term function of the patient who received this personalized reconstruction system. METHODS: Between September 2016 and June 2018, our center treated 15 patients with malignancies arising in the femur or tibia shaft using endoprosthesis with a 3D-printed custom-made stem. Osseointegration and aseptic loosening were assessed with digital tomosynthesis. Complications were recorded by reviewing the patients' records. The function was evaluated with the 1993 version of the Musculoskeletal Tumor Society (MSTS-93) score at a median of 42 (range, 34 to 54) months after reconstruction. RESULTS: One patient who experienced early aseptic loosening was managed with immobilization and bisphosphonates infusion. All implants were well osseointegrated at the final follow-up examination. There are two periprosthetic fractures intraoperatively. The wire was applied to assist fixation, and the fracture healed at the latest follow-up. Two patients experienced significant leg length discrepancies. The median MSTS-93 score was 26 (range, 23 to 30). CONCLUSIONS: A 3D-printed custom-made ultra-short stem with a porous structure provides acceptable early outcomes in patients who received peri-knee metaphyseal reconstruction. With detailed preoperative design and precise intraoperative techniques, the reasonable initial stability benefits osseointegration to osteoconductive porous titanium, and therefore ensures short- and possibly long-term durability. Personalized adaptive endoprosthesis, careful intraoperative operation, and strict follow-up management enable effective prevention and treatment of complications. The functional results in our series were acceptable thanks to reliable fixation in the bone-endoprosthesis interface and an individualized rehabilitation program. These positive results indicate this device series can be a feasible alternative for critical bone defect reconstruction. Nevertheless, longer follow-up is required to determine whether this technique is superior to other forms of fixation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印多孔钛假体在骨缺损重建中的应用，但缺乏对力学性能、应力遮挡或疲劳行为的分析。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding analysis, no LPBF fabrication characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估3D打印定制超短短柄多孔假体在膝关节周围骨缺损重建中的效果
summary_zh.method: 对15例恶性肿瘤患者植入3D打印定制假体，随访评估骨整合和并发症
summary_zh.result: 假体骨整合良好，短期功能可接受，但出现2例假体周围骨折和2例肢体不等长
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访结合数字断层合成和MSTS-93评分

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate short-term osseointegration, complications, and functional outcomes of a 3D-printed custom-made ultra-short stem with porous structure for peri-knee metaphyseal reconstruction after tumor resection.
summary_en.method: A case series of 15 patients treated with a personalized 3D-printed porous titanium endoprosthesis, assessed with digital tomosynthesis and MSTS-93 score.
summary_en.result: All implants showed good osseointegration at final follow-up, with a median MSTS-93 score of 26; two periprosthetic fractures and two leg length discrepancies occurred.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up with digital tomosynthesis imaging and functional scoring.
